messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Increased tokenization/parsing errors observed on /v1/generate (eu-west-1). Error rate ~8% over last 3m. Pager routed to oncall-alex.

oncall-alex: Seeing the alerts, I’m investigating logs and request traces. Kicking off local repro against eu cluster. Ping @eng-sre-jordan for deeper infra checks and @comms-sam for status page draft.

eng-sre-jordan: I’m on it. Initial look at nginx+ingress logs shows 5xx during chunked request handling paired with our tokenizer service returning 400-ish parse failures. Spinning a debug instance to replicate with incoming headers.

product-lina: Quick ask — can we estimate customer impact for status page? Is this limited to streaming generation or all /generate calls?

oncall-alex: Early read: both streaming and non-streaming appear affected when input length > ~2k tokens. Short prompts look fine. Preliminary customer impact estimate: ~6-10% of requests in eu region; global unaffected so far.

comms-sam: Drafting initial status page. Proposed copy below, please review and edit.

comms-sam: ```
We are investigating increased error rates for generation requests in eu-west-1. Users may experience failed or truncated responses for long prompts. Our engineers are actively investigating and working on a mitigation.

- Component: Generation API (eu-west-1)
- Impact: Partial, ~6-10% of requests for long prompts may return errors or truncated responses
- Action: Mitigation in progress; status updates every ~20 minutes

We will update this page with findings and an ETA for full recovery. For urgent impact, please contact support.
```

eng-platform-maya: Thanks, small edits: change "long prompts" -> "inputs > ~2000 tokens" and add note: "No customer data was exposed" — can we confirm?

eng-sre-jordan: Confirmed no data exfiltration vector seen in traces. Tokenizer crashes appear to be resource/edge-case parsing defects.

comms-sam: Updated draft with edits: ```
We are investigating increased error rates for generation requests in eu-west-1. Requests with inputs > ~2000 tokens may return errors or truncated responses.

- Component: Generation API (eu-west-1)
- Impact: Partial (~6-10% of requests with long inputs)
- Statement: No evidence of data exposure
- Action: Engineers implementing a hotfix and rolling out a fallback parser to reduce error rates.
- Updates: Every 20 minutes
```

oncall-alex: Working on rollback to previous tokenizer + staged rollout of fallback parser. I’ll coordinate canary in eu-west-1 cluster and report back.

eng-sre-jordan: Canary started on 2 nodes (20% traffic). Initial telemetry looks promising — error rate on canary traffic down to ~1.2%. Holding for 10m to verify.

ops-zoe: If canary holds, what’s our plan for publishing the first page update? We should avoid alarming language and include mitigation step.

comms-sam: Proposed UPDATE 1 to publish once canary is healthy: ```
Update (20m): We implemented a staged fallback parser for long inputs in eu-west-1. Canary rollout (20% traffic) reduced error rates from ~8% to ~1.2%. We are expanding the rollout and monitoring.
```

product-lina: Good. Also add guidance: "If you see failures, retry once — most requests succeed on retry."

comms-sam: Added retry guidance. Final sign-off? @eng-sre-jordan @oncall-alex

eng-sre-jordan: Sign-off from SRE side. Canary stable for 12m, no regressions.

oncall-alex: Ops + eng sign-off. Proceed to publish.

comms-sam: Publishing initial post + UPDATE 1 now. Posting link once live.

incident-bot: STATUSPAGE POSTED: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/2026-03-17-eu-generation-degradation (initial + update 1)

comms-sam: Link confirmed live. I’ll keep cadence for another 40m and post resolved notice when rollout completes.

eng-platform-maya: Rolling full rollout to remaining nodes now (gradual, 5 nodes every 3m). Telemetry sag looks steady.

eng-sre-jordan: Observed global error rate in eu cluster fall to ~0.9% during rollout. Monitoring for backpressure.

oncall-alex: UPDATE 2 (40m): Full rollout at ~80% complete, error rate plateauing under 1%. No customer escalations reported to support.

product-lina: Please include a short customer-facing post-resolve note about retries and our plan for a permanent fix (tokenizer patch + fuzz testing).

comms-sam: Drafting resolved notice: ```
Resolved: We’ve rolled out a fallback parser for inputs > ~2000 tokens in eu-west-1 and observed error rates return to baseline (<1%). Impacted requests should now succeed; if you continue to see issues, please retry once and contact support. We will deploy a permanent tokenizer fix and additional fuzz testing in the coming days.
```

eng-sre-jordan: LGTM. Add "root cause: tokenizer edge-case when parsing certain unicode sequences" if we’re comfortable with that wording now?

oncall-alex: We have root-cause confidence from stack traces: tokenizer crash on certain unicode sequences with long input. Fine to include as preliminary root cause.

comms-sam: Publishing resolved notice now.

incident-bot: STATUSPAGE UPDATE: Resolved post published (https://status.redwood.example/incidents/2026-03-17-eu-generation-degradation/resolved)

ops-zoe: Thanks everyone. Quick internal note — please archive logs for this window and attach the repro snippet to the postmortem.

eng-sre-jordan: Will capture logs and upload repro. I’ll start the postmortem template after first pass of the root cause.

comms-sam: Closing this thread for publish confirmation. I’ll push the customer email template to the shared drive. If you spot any wording issues in the status page, flag me. :thumbsup:
